name: Cal Coast Credit Union Open Air Theatre

bagPolicy.summary: The theatre admits clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or one-gallon clear bags and nonclear clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. Oversized bags and backpacks are not admitted.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Use SDSU Parking 3 or 6/6B for events; parking is $40 per vehicle, payable by credit or debit card or mobile wallet. Lots generally open 90 minutes before the doors.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The theatre guide points rideshare users to designated SDSU campus pickup and drop-off areas, without identifying a single theatre-specific curb.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The guide lists food and drink concessions on the upper concourse and says the venue is cashless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating is available on each level. Guests needing sign-language interpretation should contact the venue at least three weeks before the event; assistive listening devices are available at Guest Services by the VIP/Pass Gate with a photo ID.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The theatre guide says re-entry is typically not permitted after leaving; check the event-specific instructions.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The theatre box office at the main gate opens only on event days. Ticketmaster replacement tickets may be collected at Viejas Arena will call on the day of the event; hours vary.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The theatre guide says gates typically open 60 to 90 minutes before the event, with exact timing varying by show.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
